name: Learning reader — apply
objective: Apply half of the learning-reader pair: build P29's signed design and decisions - books, chapters, image assets and per-reader state (resume position, bookmarks, highlights and notes, quiz results, spaced-repetition review) on the server; the library, book page and reader with one scroller and no iframe height handshake (legacy HTML explainers full-screen); the new chapter format in this repo's /explain copies - verified in the operator runtime on phone, iPad and desktop, closing with the handoff note for the bootstrap workspace repo's /explain.

review.note: operator-reported (walkthrough 2026-10-21): (1) the bottom bar comes up on even a very slight scroll up, super annoying — stick it to the bottom, a drawer the user can bring while reading; (2) on PC the header (logo, back, Display) is not hidden, it follows the scroll — hide it scrolling down, show it only when the user taps the screen or scrolls up. 'you may just fix like what I just said'.
